scope: Native Hyperliquid crypto perps only; HIP-3/XYZ, spot, and metal-backed proxies excluded
method: Discovery uses cohort largest-position samples and prior watch rows. Wallets prioritize large nearby positions, closest estimates, and largest notional. Only fresh successful native account reads enter this observation. Distances use each position’s own mark (positionValue / abs(szi)) and reported liquidation price. Long distance=(mark−liquidation)/mark; short distance=(liquidation−mark)/mark. Liquidation prices are estimates, not fixed triggers or predicted executions. This is a bounded verified sample, not the global largest/closest-position ranking.
